question: ________ emerged as the poorest state as per the first-ever Multi-dimensional Poverty Index (MPI) prepared by Niti Aayog and launched in November 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Multi-dimensional Poverty Index (MPI):- 
 
 
• The MPI takes into account multiple factors such as **health, education, and standard of living** to measure poverty.
 
• The index is aimed at identifying the **poorest households and regions** in the country, and helping policymakers to design targeted interventions.
 
• Bihar emerged as the poorest state as per the first-ever Multi-dimensional Poverty Index (MPI) prepared by Niti Aayog and launched in November 2021.
 
• Bihar's poverty rate stands at** 52.9%**, which is higher than the national average of **27.9%.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madhya Pradesh** has a** poverty rate **of **41.5%** according to the MPI, while** Uttar Pradesh **has a poverty rate of **29.4%.**
 
• **Mizoram** is** not** among the 22 states covered by the MPI.
